method.method_draft: First describe the non-arrow contents of the image: the lower structure is a carboxylate with R attached to the carbonyl carbon, one C=O bond, one C-O^- bond, and a nearby Ag+ ion; the upper structure is an X-X bonded pair. Then ignore all curved arrows as instructed. Convert R and X labels to wildcard '*' atoms, encode the carboxylate as *C(=O)[O-], encode silver as [Ag+], encode X-X as **, and join disconnected species with periods to obtain *C(=O)[O-].[Ag+].**.
